title: Concentration in degree minus one for a Koszul quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and f:Fin r\to R a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. For every standard cotangent-resolution coherence C [def-trf-cotangent-resolution-data], let L be its cotangent complex for R\to R/(f). Then L lies both in D≥−1 and D≤−1 for the standard t-structure on the ordinary module derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Form the polynomial square of the Koszul quotient. Its canonical derived multiplication is invertible, so cotangent base change identifies the quotient cotangent complex with the derived scalar extension of the polynomial augmentation cotangent complex.

The polynomial augmentation theorem identifies that complex with the single conormal J/J² in degree −1 and supplies its variable basis over ℤ. Thus J/J² is free and flat. The single complex is K-flat; the universal scalar-extension counit computes its derived extension as the single of its ordinary scalar extension in the same degree.

A single module in degree −1 belongs to both t-structure bounds. Transport these bounds along the composite isomorphism. No identification of the resulting ordinary tensor with I/I² is required, and empty sequences and zero rings use the identical calculation.

theorem koszul_cotangent_concentrated
    [∀ B : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (C : Coherence.{u}) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → R)
    (hreg : RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    let L := cotangentComplex C
      (Arrow.mk (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)))))
    L.IsGE (-1) ∧ L.IsLE (-1)
